test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

The following bar graph shows the number of students passed in class XII board exam from six different institutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08ae759f379620eb8000b45aca44aa9df5ca4433fd00d9427c00438ef7d9bb29.png] 

Students passed from institutions U, T, P and Q together is how much more than that of institutes S and R together?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08ae759f379620eb8000b45aca44aa9df5ca4433fd00d9427c00438ef7d9bb29.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Number of students passed from U, T, P, and Q = 70 + 90 + 120 + 100

⇒ Number of students passed from U, T, P, and Q = 380

⇒ Number of students passed from S and R = 85 + 60 = 145

Difference = 380 – 145 = 235

**Therefore, Students passed from institutions U, T, P, and Q together is 235 more than that institutes S and R together.**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3).**
